summary.zh: 两个内测入场体验修复：输入邀请码切换到内测通道后，应用现在会立即检查并发现内测版本，不再需要重启或等待下一轮自动检查；此外，当本机内容其实已经是最新时点击更新，不再误报红色的“检查更新失败”，而是正确显示“已是最新”。
summary.en: Two fixes for the beta onboarding experience: after entering an invite code and switching to the beta channel, the app now checks immediately and discovers the beta build — no restart or waiting for the next scheduled check. Also, clicking update on a machine whose content is already current no longer shows a false red “check failed”; it now correctly reports being up to date.

title.zh: 输码切换通道后立即检查更新
title.en: Update check fires immediately after invite activation

summary.zh: 此前兑换邀请码切换通道后没有任何即时动作，要等下一轮自动检查（最长 4 小时）或重启应用才会发现内测版本。现在切换完成的瞬间就发起检查，内测版本立刻出现。
summary.en: Previously, switching channels after redeeming an invite code triggered nothing until the next scheduled check (up to 4 hours) or an app restart. The check now fires the moment the switch completes, so the beta build appears immediately.

details.zh: 该检查失败不会影响已完成的通道切换，后续的定时检查会照常兜底。
details.en: If that immediate check fails, the completed channel switch is unaffected and the scheduled checks still cover it.

sources.title: fix(updater): check immediately on invite activation; treat an already-current apply as up to date

title.zh: “已是最新”不再误报为检查更新失败
title.en: Being already up to date no longer reports as a failed check

summary.zh: 当本机内容已经追平或超过更新源（例如后台已自动拉取过、或连点了两次更新）时，点击更新会撞上安全防回滚检查并把“并不比当前新”当成错误显示。现在这种情况会被正确识别为“已是最新”，界面状态同步恢复正常。
summary.en: When local content already caught up with or passed the update source (a background pull, or clicking update twice), the apply hit the anti-rollback safety gate and displayed “not newer than current” as an error. This situation is now correctly recognized as up to date, and the card state resets accordingly.

details.zh: 防回滚保护本身保持不变——仍然拒绝应用更旧的内容；改变的只是“无可应用”这一正常终态的呈现方式。
details.en: The anti-rollback protection itself is unchanged — older content is still refused; only the presentation of the normal “nothing to apply” terminal state changed.

sources.title: fix(updater): check immediately on invite activation; treat an already-current apply as up to date
